decisions.reason: After two years this analytics add-on still fits tightly with the firm's market-data platform and likely costs little to maintain, so its option value remains higher than the case for abandonment.

The gas tariff comparison product is close to the core offer and worth keeping while customer demand continues to clarify, although by now the firm would expect clearer traction than in its first year.

Because the regional electricity tariff calculator is very near the firm's established calculation and process-support business, management would typically retain it as a low-risk extension with cross-selling potential.

This broader multi-model tariff line has weaker commitment signals than products with their own pages, but as a platform-related product family it still offers enough learning and variant-selection value to keep for now.
The area definition tool builds on existing data and workflow capabilities, so a medium-sized German software firm would usually keep it unless evidence of persistently weak uptake becomes clearer.

Given its lighter website presence, overlap with other tariff-comparison options and the fact that two years should have revealed much of its market potential, management would now be inclined to reallocate resources elsewhere.
